title: AssetVersion
description: One asset version as the scene-api publishes it: liveness, entitlements and source ids. Served for retired versions too, so a consumer can confirm a purge.

retired_at.description: When the last source reference was removed; null while live.

oneOf.description: UTC timestamp, RFC 3339 with a 'Z' suffix.

entitlements.description: Union of the entitlements of every source holding the version, sorted. Empty once retired.

sources.description: Source references currently holding the version. Empty once retired.

source.description: One source system's reference to the asset version; the connector's location is internal and not published.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier of the item within its source; survives content changes.
